title: Trex Celebrates 30 Years Of Innovation With Performance-Driven Exhibition At The 2026 International Builders Show
summary: WINCHESTER, Va. (February 12, 2026) – In 1996, four executives from Mobil’s Composite Products Division acquired the rights to a groundbreaking wood-alternative decking material, launching a company that redefined the decking industry. Three decades later, Trex Company [NYSE:TREX] is the world’s leading brand of composite decking and railing, and a driving force behind the evolution of outdoor living. At IBS 2026, Trex will build on its legacy of innovation and disruption by unveiling a striking new exhibit that brings performance, beauty and sustainability to life – setting the stage for the next chapter of the brand and the future of the category it pioneered.
